# Appeal of Denial — Neck (Cervical) Fusion (ACDF), CPT 22551

**Member:** Skyler Mercado
**Member ID:** W988378527
**Plan:** Priority Health (Commercial/ACA), Michigan
**Reference number:** POC-B7C7B913DC-54149
**Date of denial notice:** 2026-08-01
**Governing policy:** PH Medical Policy 91581-R23 SPINE PROCEDURES (https://priorityhealth.stylelabs.cloud/api/public/content/5f005b3ee3044b68ad920d57974c2d68?v=785108c8)

Dear Priority Health Appeals Department,

I am appealing the denial of my requested cervical fusion surgery (ACDF, CPT 22551), which was denied on 2026-08-01 as not medically necessary. I am asking Priority Health to reconsider this decision at Level 1 of the appeals process. My surgeon, Dr. Marchetti, has documented that this procedure is needed, and I do not believe the denial reflects the full record.

## The Plan's Own Policy

PH Medical Policy 91581-R23 states:

> "Cervical Spine Fusion procedures are medically necessary according to TurningPoint criteria."

This is the standard the plan says it applied to my case. However, the denial notice I received does not tell me what the specific TurningPoint criteria are, or which part of those criteria my records supposedly fail to meet. It only states that the procedure "does not meet the plan's criteria for medical necessity," without identifying which criterion. I cannot fully respond to a standard I have not been shown, and I do not believe a fair review can be completed without it.

## My Medical Records

The following is what is documented in my prior authorization packet:

- **Duration and severity:** 18 months of progressive neck pain, unrelieved by rest.
- **Conservative treatment already completed:** 10 weeks of supervised physical therapy (cervical traction and postural training), 18 visits, from 2026-04-12 to 2026-06-21, documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- **Medication trial:** NSAIDs for 6 months with inadequate relief.
- **Injection:** A corticosteroid injection on 2026-05-22 gave only 4 weeks of partial relief.
- **Imaging:** MRI of the cervical spine on 2026-05-20 showed a C5-C6 disc herniation with severe right foraminal narrowing and C6 nerve root compression.
- **Symptoms and exam findings:** Radicular pain and numbness into the right thumb and index finger, with weakness; positive provocative testing on the affected side; and a neurologic deficit corresponding to the imaged level.
- **No contraindications noted:** No active infection, no untreated substance use, BMI 29, non-smoker.

Taken together, these records show a documented structural cause for my symptoms (imaging-confirmed nerve root compression at the corresponding level), a corresponding neurologic exam finding, and a sustained, unsuccessful trial of conservative treatment including physical therapy, medication, and injection. This is the clinical picture my surgeon relied on in recommending surgery.

## Request for the Criteria Applied

Because PH Medical Policy 91581-R23 defers to TurningPoint's clinical review criteria rather than stating the specific requirements itself, I am requesting that Priority Health provide me, in writing, the complete TurningPoint criteria used to evaluate cervical spine fusion (CPT 22551) under policy 91581-R23, including any point-by-point requirements applied to my case. I understand these may be available through Priority Health's Prism portal (Authorizations > Authorization Criteria Lookup) or directly from TurningPoint, and I am requesting that a copy be sent to me and/or to Dr. Marchetti's office so that the specific basis for this denial can be addressed directly.

## Closing Request

I am asking that Priority Health reconsider this denial in light of the records described above, and that it provide the specific TurningPoint criteria applied to my case so that I can respond fully if any additional information is needed. I understand my appeal must be received by 2027-01-28, and that the plan uses a three-level process, with Level 1 review within 180 days, Level 2 within 90 days, and a state external review available afterward within 127 days if needed. I am submitting this appeal now so it can be reviewed as soon as possible.

I can be reached at [phone number] or [email address] if any further information is needed. Please send your response, and the requested criteria, to the address below.

Thank you for your time and reconsideration.

Sincerely,

Skyler Mercado
Member ID: W988378527
[Mailing address]
[Phone number]
[Email address]
[Date]

---

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
